title: fix(core,app-shell): an unlabelled undoable action's Undo / Redo toast names the object, with no English verb (objectui#11080)
body:
Fixes #11080

Clause-②: no

The remaining half of objectui#11080, after PR objectui#11150 (the pack-keyed Undo / Redo prefixes) merged. Direction is triage's answer E on the card (`5900694360`): the fallback drops its English verb and names the object; no new key, and `UndoableOperation` is not touched.

## What changed

An `undoable` update whose action declared no `label` (or an empty one) described its operation as `Undo ` plus the object's API name, in three places. Each now writes only the object identifier it already holds:

- `ActionRunner` in `@object-ui/core`: `action.label || objectName`
- the console runtime's `api` handler (`useConsoleActionRuntime`): `action.label || obj`
- `RecordDetailView`'s `api` handler: `action.label || targetObject`

Since PR objectui#11150 the global Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z toast says Undo or Redo itself from `actions.undoneOperation` / `actions.redoneOperation`. The fallback's own `Undo ` therefore doubled the verb on undo and was wrong on redo. Under zh-CN, before and after:

- undo: `撤销：Undo crm_call` becomes `撤销：crm_call`
- redo: `重做：Undo crm_call` becomes `重做：crm_call`
- en: `Undo: Undo crm_call` becomes `Undo: crm_call`, and `Redo: Undo crm_call` becomes `Redo: crm_call`

No per-producer variation: all three name the object by its API name, app-shell does not use the object's label where core uses the API name. No new key, no export, no published type moves (`Clause-②: no`). No migration: a stack restored from `objectui:undo-history` keeps the description it was saved with. Changeset: patch on `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

Reach, as triage graded it (p3): the fallback is reached only by an undoable action with an empty or missing `label`, that is an authored `label: ''` or a code-built `ActionDef`.

## Pins

- `packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.undoFallbackDescription-11080.test.ts` (4 tests): the runner renders no toast, so it pins the operation it pushes. No label, an empty label and an action-named object give the object identifier exactly; an authored label is byte-identical.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.undoFallbackObject-11080.test.tsx` (12 tests, three producers times four cases): each REAL producer (the runner, the console runtime's `api` handler on a real runner, the record page's `api` handler through the probe of `RecordDetailView.undoCapture-11082`) leaves its operation on the real `globalUndoManager`; the real `AppContent` under a real `I18nProvider` then has Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z pressed on `window`. zh: no label and empty label read `撤销：crm_call` then `重做：crm_call`; en control reads `Undo: crm_call` then `Redo: crm_call`; an authored label reaches both zh toasts byte for byte.
- PR objectui#11150's labelled-action pin (`AppContent.undoRedoToast-11080`) is untouched and green. Pins moved: none. No existing test asserted the literal `Undo ` plus an object (`git grep` over test sources for the three spellings, zero hits).

Direction observed: red on exactly that producer's zh x2 and en cases, its label control and the other producers green. The first red in the app-shell pin is the toast text itself: zh received `撤销：Undo crm_call` and `重做：Undo crm_call`, en received `Undo: Undo crm_call` and `Redo: Undo crm_call`.

  - console runtime: `Tests 3 failed | 9 passed (12)`.
  - record page: `Tests 3 failed | 9 passed (12)`.

Both `tsconfig.test.json` list the new pins (`--listFilesOnly`, 1 each).
- Gates, exit 0 each, rerun at head `23aca049c`: `check-changeset-presence` (5 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; three pending changesets name `RecordDetailView.tsx` or `ActionRunner.ts`, each paragraph read, none falsified: they concern the retired DetailView array, JSDoc default tags and the action-keys warning text), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check-changeset-no-major`.

## Declared narrowing

eslint ran on the 5 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`) at `5e34d5c88`, and on the one file changed since at head (0 errors, 0 warnings): 5 files, 0 errors, 169 warnings, none on a changed line (the warnings are the pre-existing `no-explicit-any` and hooks rules in the two large files). The population is the diff's files and the count is 5 from the JSON. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` (type-aware linting is off) and neither it nor `eslint-rules/` reads a file from disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the `check:*` farm are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- Not filed, carrier none, read from source and not measured in a browser: `ActionRunner` registers an undoable result on the global stack only from its success-toast branch, so a runner with no toast handler answers `result.undo` without pushing it. The console always installs a toast handler; a headless runner would offer no Ctrl+Z. Zero pull today.
